title: Digital Literacy
description: Introduces concepts and practices in internet-enabled learning environments. Examines how digital, networked and open access technologies can enrich learning and the learning of others in an interconnected world in which learners locate, curate and disseminate knowledge. Learners develop portfolios and lifelong access to learning networks that contribute to their professional practice in legal, safe, consensual and ethical ways, based on their understanding of intellectual property and their rights, responsibilities and opportunities.
